mapper.sql: a.id, a.user_id, a.username, a.password_hash, a.role, a.status, a.failed_login_attempts, a.locked_until, u.nickname, u.avatar_url
mapper.insert: insert into users (id, handle, nickname, avatar_url, bio, source) values (#{id}, #{handle}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{bio}, 'app')
insert into accounts (id, user_id, username, password_hash, role, status, generated) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, 'user', 'active', false)
mapper.select: select from accounts a join users u on u.id = a.user_id where a.username = #{username}
select from accounts a join users u on u.id = a.user_id where a.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into auth_refresh_tokens (id, account_id, token_hash, expires_at) values (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: select rt.id as refresh_id, rt.expires_at, rt.revoked_at, a.id as account_id, a.user_id, a.username, a.password_hash, a.role, a.status, a.failed_login_attempts, a.locked_until, u.nickname, u.avatar_url from auth_refresh_tokens rt join accounts a on a.id = rt.account_id join users u on u.id = a.user_id where rt.token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: update auth_refresh_tokens rt set revoked_at = current_timestamp where rt.revoked_at is null and exists ( select 1 from accounts a where a.id = rt.account_id and a.user_id = #{userId} )
